definitions: A topographic or habitational surname from Middle English for someone who lived near a hawthorn hedge or in a place with such a name.

Numerous places:
An eastern suburb of the City of Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.
Numerous places in the United States:
A city in Los Angeles County, California. 
A city in Alachua County, Florida.
A township in White County, Illinois.
An unincorporated community in Montgomery County, Iowa.
An eastern neighbourhood of Louisville, Kentucky.
A northern neighbourhood of Minneapolis, Minnesota.
A census-designated place, the county seat of Mineral County, Nevada.
A borough in Passaic County, New Jersey. 
A census-designated place in the town of Mount Pleasant, Westchester County, New York. 
A district of Portland, Oregon, named after James C. Hawthorne.
A neighbourhood in south Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
A neighbourhood in north-west Washington, D.C..
A town and unincorporated community therein, in Douglas County, Wisconsin.
Former name of Cicero: a town in Cook County, Illinois.

blocks.text: Hawthorne is an inner-city suburb of the City of Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.

Hawthorne Village is a suburban community in Milton, Ontario. It was established by Mattamy Homes in 1999. Hawthorne Village has 3500 families. In 2002 Hawthorne Village was awarded "Project of the Year" by the Ontario Home Builders Association and "Community of the Year" by the Greater Toronto Homebuilders Association.

Hawthorne is an American medical drama television series created by John Masius. It starred Jada Pinkett Smith and Michael Vartan and premiered on TNT on June 16, 2009. On September 16, 2010, it was announced that Hawthorne had been renewed for a third season consisting of ten episodes. The season premiered on June 14, 2011, and ended on August 16, 2011.
